comments.author: Lena
comments.body: TC max sail improvement is only +90v/h as well. This ship accelerates a lot faster than a TC will ever hope to. It turns better, doesn't get stuck as often on shallow shores like a clipper or galleon. It may not have the top speeds of a TC in deep open sea, but it's a better choice for beginner to intermediate adventuring in Europe, Red Sea, Persian Gulf and even short port hops in the Caribbean and SEA. All that, it's still not worth 1bil though.

comments.author: Mei Hua
comments.body: I find it interesting that nobody considers this ship for piracy, it is the perfect pirate ship. With R20 min. cargo providing plenty of speed and acceleration, excellent turn & wave resistance, good crew (90) to overcome traders and great ship skills (EA, heavy bombing & high lookout. To top it all it has 4 cannon slots to help in escape if attacked by maritimers.

comments.author: Jafar
comments.body: Xebecs, frigates and corvettes have a "hidden" value that make them faster than expected just seeing sail power. A royal frigate can be fast as a trade clipper (both improved), and this ship is like that. Too bad that now 60+ clippers are faster and more useful, but this xebecs are excelent as "mid-high" speed ships... problem about prices, too, is that arent "final" ships so cant be expected a very high price.

comments.author: Lewis
comments.body:
Lavendermyst here. I am a converted believer, with it s fully modded,
my stats are v sails 381 h sails 357, turn 30, wr is 14, Armour 34.

crew max is 60, guns max is 66 cargo is 369.

This ship is specifically for port hopping, during 2 x event, I was either running edin-hamburg run for grinding trade skills or Jamaica-Santiago doing the same. the beauty of this ship is that it accelerates so fast that my fleet mate comments that it is like having a death wish as it tries to go clashing into the land. PM ingame for a test ride and believe, for those that thought it have less then optimal cargo, I have a RBTC and a FTaruk as back up.

comments.author: Theo
comments.body:
I think the people running around saying how bad this ship is, have never actually used one. They accelerate out of port like a barca and have the top end speed of the clippers. They are faster than their sail numbers indicate so if you are just looking at them "on paper" they don't look as good.

Hell "on paper" a large galleon looks faster than a cruise light clipper, but anybody who has used both ships knows the clc is much faster.

This is the same idea here.
